Name: happy smiling farmer sprite
Author: isari112
Description: It's a simple edit of the farmer's sprite that adds a smile and a few other expression edits. Includes both male and female sprite. Should be compatible with other mods, and doesn't require content patcher, just replace the xnb file. Made as a base for NPC mod, but it's free to use of course! It's a simple edit, so do whatever you want with it, include it in other mods and such, I don't mind. :)
